transcript: I don't know how they do it every year, but somehow miscast just continues to one up itself every single time. And Miscast 2026 is definitely no exception. It is one of my favorite nights of the year for a reason. And I feel like in recent years there has been the shift towards more elaborate performances, whether that's full costumes like Darren Criss in full Annie drag, Alex Brightman and Sara Chase from schmigadoon dressed as Mungojerrie and Rumpleteazer from the classic production of cats, which also included full choreography, along with Jane Krakowsky's performance of you're never fully dressed without A smile from Annie, and Emma Sofia from Cat's The Jellicle Ball doing a full Vogue version of I can do that from A Chorus Line. And one of my favourite miscast is when performers will sing songs originated by other people in attendance. So we had Lea Michele singing Don Quixote from man of LA Mancha in front of Brian Stokes Mitchell, and Brian Stokes Mitchell singing back to before from ragtime in front of Caissie Levy My two favorite performances of the evening were Caissie Levy singing what do I need with love from Thoroughly Modern Millie as a tribute to Gavin Creel, because let's face it, no miscast feels complete without mentioning him. And Nic Christopher absolutely singing the hell out of easy as life from Aida. There are, of course, some other really great performances from people like Jessica Vosk, Sam Tutty and Christiani Pitts from two strangers, Ali and LJ From Lost Boys, Ruthie ann Miles, M J Rodriguez, Tranmell Tillman from Severance, and of course Marla Mendelle as Celine Dion. But I am not going to spoil what they sung. It will be streaming completely for free May 12 on YouTube. And trust me when I say you do not wanna miss it.
classificationReason: Detailed recap of the Miscast 2026 gala event (multiple performers, multiple songs from various shows). Not a single listed production; no first-hand review of any one show.
